Stage 3 supplies three match values, three secondary comparison bytes and three action indices. The matched, unused entry at $24A3 selects a routine via the resident $73DA/$73E4 pointer pair.

Stage 3 tile property table indexed by character code. The colour pass starting at $126B copies the low four bits to colour RAM, and the terrain test at $292F reads the full byte.
